purpose: Blind multi-material falsification of the MECH3A-selected path-geometric hydraulic-diffusivity penetration scale.

external_parameter_authority.source: Carsel and Parrish (1988) USDA textural-class van Genuchten parameters as reproduced in HYDRUS; Mualem pore-connectivity l=0.5
external_parameter_authority.selection_rule: Three a-priori textural anchors spanning coarse, medium and fine hydraulic behavior; no material was chosen from a MECH3 response.

unchanged_experiment.bottom_boundary: FIXED_FLUX q_bottom=K0 in positive-downward normalized convention
unchanged_experiment.standard_lare_operator: unchanged CA1 adjacent-layer Taylor closure; MECH3B evaluates projected interface-flux error only, not LARE state propagation

selected_scale_definition.target_state: theta_f solves K(theta_f)=r*K(theta0), r=1.5 WET or 0.5 DRY
selected_scale_definition.frozen_ladder_prediction: nearest member of 10,20,...,140 cm to L_pred_continuous; exact ties choose the smaller L; outside-range predictions are censored to the nearest endpoint and marked censored

reference_domain_policy.case_use: Only QUALIFIED WET/DRY cases contribute peak locations. Every excluded case and its reason is reported.
reference_domain_policy.minimum_for_panel_adjudication: At least two of three materials must each supply at least one qualified WET and one qualified DRY case, and at least 10 qualified WET/DRY cases must exist overall. Otherwise close BLIND_PANEL_REFERENCE_INSUFFICIENT.

per_case: continuous and snapped peak prediction for each scale
absolute log prediction error for each scale
pooled: pooled std ln(lambda) for selected and baseline
std across material mean ln(lambda) for selected and baseline
RMS absolute log peak-prediction error using frozen discovery c for selected and baseline

adjudication.NONLINEAR_SCALE_TRANSFER_SUPPORTED: Panel authority sufficient and PATH_GEOMETRIC_D improves on LOCAL_D0 in all three primary pooled criteria: pooled ln(lambda) std, between-material mean-ln(lambda) std, and RMS log prediction error using the frozen discovery constants.
adjudication.NONLINEAR_SCALE_TRANSFER_PARTIAL: Panel authority sufficient and PATH_GEOMETRIC_D improves on LOCAL_D0 in one or two of the three primary pooled criteria.
adjudication.NONLINEAR_SCALE_TRANSFER_NOT_SUPPORTED: Panel authority sufficient and PATH_GEOMETRIC_D improves on LOCAL_D0 in none of the three primary pooled criteria.
adjudication.BLIND_PANEL_REFERENCE_INSUFFICIENT: Reference-domain minimum not met under unchanged authority.

interpretation_firewalls: Exact snapped peak hit count is diagnostic and does not override the three pooled criteria.
No Carsel-Parrish material may be removed because it performs badly.
No new multiplier or alternative theta_f rule may be introduced after new trajectories are exposed.
A supported result is evidence only for this fixed-flux pulse mechanism, not a universal LARE grid criterion.
A partial or negative result closes this scalar-scaling attempt; do not refit on the blind panel.
